headline: Western Flanks and Islands Flare as Central Fronts Grind
war_summary: Fresh structural fighting has shifted outward to island and western sectors over the past three hours, even as central battlefields settle into grinding attrition. Palantine Berm and Godcrofts remain volatile hotbeds, with Palantine Berm recording further base exchanges across Vendett and Windburn Landing while Godcrofts tallied four recent actions. To the west, Farranac Coast logged two rapid base flips at Transient Valley amid heavy losses exceeding twenty-nine hundred total casualties in two hours, and Nevish Line saw renewed contest over Tomb Father. Conversely, previous hotspots in Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf recorded no base transfers during the last two hours, marking a brief stabilization of local lines despite persistent skirmishing. Massive casualty spikes without immediate territorial shifts erupted along Callahan's Passage, Dead Lands, and Weathered Expanse, where over two thousand combatants fell per sector under sharply accelerating engagements.
